purpose: Describe whether existing quiet-period loss remains within retrospective classes and within matched chains; no causal identification.
known_exposed_findings: Original class3 and marginal quiet-period deficits, negative fixed ridge probes.
normalizers: Frozen global weighted clipped moments from analysis-01/results.json, no refitting or subgroup normalization
outputs: class x fold x all seven existing age bins additive loss and mass
matched chain fresh-vs-quiet conditional intensity, median/sign counts and pooled mass, all classes/folds
paired_eligibility: Each population has positive target weight for BOTH targets; entire chains never split.
